premise: Bear cub doesn't want to miss a single thing all winter, but his yawns win; Badger digs him a cosy hollow, Flower folds up too, and when the spring sun comes they wake up together.
inspiration: Rip Van Winkle, turned: the long sleep is safe, a friend keeps a promise, and nothing good was missed.
lesson: Friends keep watch while you rest.
learning: Bears sleep through most of the winter.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Sleeps Till Spring
en-US.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6 16s} It was autumn, and the leaves {sfx:leaves} came twirling down. {bear:enter} Bear cub gave a great big yawn. {bear:face sad} [sad] I don't want to sleep all winter. I'll miss everything! {badger:enter} Badger trotted up. [softly] I'll wake you for the best bit. Promise. {badger:live} He dug a cosy hollow, just bear-sized. {badger:face happy} Beside them, {flower:enter} Flower {flower:tint #BFE3FF} shivered in the cool air and {flower:live hold} folded up her petals. Wake me too, she whispered. {bear:face happy} Bear cub sat down in the hollow and {bear:live hold} gave one last yawn. {canvas:snow 0.7 22s} The snowflakes came, and Bear cub slept through the whole winter, the way bears do. {sfx:snore} He slept… and slept… and slept. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} One morning, the sun came back and melted the snow. {badger:go to bear} Badger tiptoed over. [whispers] Wake up. It's the best bit. {bear:live resume} Bear cub woke with a start. {flower:live resume} Flower opened wide. {bear:face surprised} [gasps] Did I miss it? {badger:hop} No, laughed Badger. The best bit is now. {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] Good morning, spring!

es-ES.title: Osito duerme hasta la primavera
es-ES.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6 16s} Era otoño, y las hojas {sfx:leaves} bajaban dando vueltas. {bear:enter} Osito dio un bostezo enorme. {bear:face sad} [sad] No quiero dormir todo el invierno. ¡Me lo perderé todo! {badger:enter} Tejón llegó trotando. [softly] Yo te despierto para lo mejor. Prometido. {badger:live} Cavó un hueco calentito, justo de tamaño oso. {badger:face happy} A su lado, {flower:enter} Flor {flower:tint #BFE3FF} tiritó con el fresco y {flower:live hold} plegó sus pétalos. Despiértame a mí también, susurró. {bear:face happy} Osito se sentó en el hueco y {bear:live hold} dio un último bostezo. {canvas:snow 0.7 22s} Llegaron los copos de nieve, y Osito durmió todo el invierno, como hacen los osos. {sfx:snore} Durmió… y durmió… y durmió. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Una mañana volvió el sol y derritió la nieve. {badger:go to bear} Tejón se acercó de puntillas. [whispers] Despierta. Ya llega lo mejor. {bear:live resume} Osito se despertó con un respingo. {flower:live resume} Flor se abrió de par en par. {bear:face surprised} [gasps] ¿Me lo he perdido? {badger:hop} No, dijo Tejón, riendo. Lo mejor es ahora. {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] ¡Buenos días, primavera!
